verdict.rationale: Whether the product's source is readable under an open license is a fair question for a speech-to-text API vendor, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence that AssemblyAI publishes source under any open license. The Python/TypeScript SDKs and the public OpenAPI spec come with no stated license or source availability, and being free for open-source projects is a pricing policy, not open source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
